# Satva Samui Retreat Hotel

> Beachfront yoga and wellness retreat hotel on Lipa Noi beach, Koh Samui, Thailand. All-inclusive stays from $75/night (per person, double occupancy, Standard Room) covering accommodation steps from the sea, twice-daily yoga, breakfast and lunch, evening meditation, and — for stays of 7+ nights — an Ayurvedic pulse reading and wellness consultation. Average guest rating 4.8/5.

## Key facts

- Name: Satva Samui Retreat Hotel
- Type: Yoga retreat / wellness hotel with direct beach access
- Location: Lipa Noi beach, Koh Samui, Surat Thani, Thailand (USM airport)
- Price: from $75/night per person (double occupancy, Standard Room); solo rates on request
- Included in price: accommodation, breakfast & lunch, twice-daily yoga, evening meditation; for 7+ night stays also Ayurvedic pulse reading + wellness consultation and full use of saunas, gym, pools, kayaks and paddleboards
- Not included: wellness programmes, excursions, flights, transfers (airport transfer $30)
- Booking: $100 deposit per room confirms the reservation; balance due on arrival
- Suitable for: complete beginners through experienced practitioners; solo travellers and couples
- Best time to visit: comfortable weather year-round; calm sea with no strong currents
- Phone: +66 95 016 5058
- Rating: 4.8 / 5 (150 reviews)

## Frequently asked questions

- What's included from $75/night: accommodation, breakfast and lunch, twice-daily yoga, evening meditation; 7+ nights add an Ayurvedic pulse reading, wellness consultation, and use of saunas, gym, pools, kayaks and paddleboards.
- Minimum stay: any number of nights; 10+ days recommended; 7+ nights include a complimentary Ayurvedic health consultation.
- Airport transfer: arranged on request, $30.
- Yoga experience: not required — sessions are adapted from first-timers to advanced practitioners.
- Getting there: Koh Samui (USM) via Bangkok Airways; most international guests route through Bangkok (BKK/DMK) or Singapore.
- What to pack: lightweight yoga clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes; mats and beach towels provided.
